provenance.extracted_from: runs/ in governed-bi, immediately before it was deleted
provenance.why: D2 step 1 proved the three-way routing-failure split is computable from these columns with no rerun. The metric that consumes them (D2 step 2) is not built yet, and the source rows were being wiped with the rest of the pre-rebuild artifacts, so the columns are preserved here.
provenance.caveat: Pre-rebuild data. It was scored against the OLD BIRD question pool, whose gold SQL is known defective, and against corpora built with the gold-SQL-derived decoy mask. Use it to develop and sanity-check the split metric, never to quote a routing number. See docs/plans/eval-rebuild.md.

bucket_rules.picked_wrong: db_id in shortlisted_schemas but schema_pick != db_id

provenance.note: Buckets are evaluated in that order: a fallback is classified as a fallback even when the shortlist also missed, because the fallback is the actionable cause and double-counting would inflate the total.
provenance.shortlist_miss_is_unreachable_here: Every run in this extract pooled 2 or 3 schemas with route_top_k=10, so the shortlist necessarily contained the whole pool and `shortlist_miss` is 0 by construction. That is NOT evidence that retrieval is healthy. The bucket only becomes reachable when the pool is larger than top_k, i.e. on a real 69-schema run. Use this extract to develop the metric, not to conclude anything about recall.
